description: Presenting a workflow's blocking problems in one place: classification and grouping of execution and validation errors with missing nodes, missing models, missing media, and swappable nodes, the errors tab with group lists, error and missing-node cards, locate-node and selection emphasis, error report generation and actions, and the top-menu error overlay with its state. Error stores, the error catalog, and the missing-model, missing-media, and node-replacement cards remain with their records.

characterizationScenarios.name: Error groups classify execution errors, missing nodes, missing models, and swappable nodes
Errors tab cards locate nodes, report errors, and resolve missing node packs
Error overlay summarizes blocking errors and opens the errors tab

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and runtime behavior without granting public entry points or cross-module dependency permissions.
